import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, json, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
from sklearn.cluster import DBSCAN
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact, mannwhitneyu
os.makedirs('/tmp/ift',exist_ok=True)

# ---- BLOSUM / NW (compact) ----
B62="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
ls=B62.strip().split('\n');AAs=ls[0].split();MM={}
for r in ls[1:]:
    p=r.split()
    for b,v in zip(AAs,p[1:]): MM[(p[0],b)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b): return MM.get((a,b),-4)
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2);NEG=-1e9
    Mm=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    tb=np.zeros((n+1,m+1,3),np.int8);Mm[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1):Ix[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1)
    for j in range(1,m+1):Iy[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1)
    sr=np.zeros(m)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        a=s1[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1): sr[j-1]=sc(a,s2[j-1])
        c=np.vstack([Mm[i-1,:m],Ix[i-1,:m],Iy[i-1,:m]]);k=np.argmax(c,0);Mm[i,1:]=c[k,np.arange(m)]+sr;tb[i,1:,0]=k
        c=np.vstack([Mm[i-1,1:]+go,Ix[i-1,1:]+ge,Iy[i-1,1:]+go]);k=np.argmax(c,0);Ix[i,1:]=c[k,np.arange(m)];tb[i,1:,1]=k
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            cc=(Mm[i,j-1]+go,Ix[i,j-1]+go,Iy[i,j-1]+ge);k=int(np.argmax(cc));Iy[i,j]=cc[k];tb[i,j,2]=k
    i,j=n,m;s=int(np.argmax([Mm[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]]));mp=np.full(n,-1,int)
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0:s=2
        elif j==0:s=1
        if s==0: mp[i-1]=j-1;s=int(tb[i,j,0]);i-=1;j-=1
        elif s==1: s=int(tb[i,j,1]);i-=1
        else: s=int(tb[i,j,2]);j-=1
    return mp
ORTHO={'CAEEL_DYF13':'Q95QT8','HUMAN_TTC26':'A0AVF1','MOUSE_Ttc26':'Q8BS45','DANRE_ift56':'Q5PR66',
 'XENTR_ift56':'A4III8','CHLRE_IFT56':'A8JA42','TRYB2_PIFTC3':'Q57ZL2','GIAIC_IFT56':'A8BS40',
 'RAT_Ttc26':'Q5U2N8','MACFA_TTC26':'Q4R7Z9'}
seqs={n:''.join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split('\n')[1:]).strip() for n,a in ORTHO.items()}
ref=seqs['CAEEL_DYF13'];L=len(ref)
cols={'CAEEL_DYF13':np.array(list(ref))};maps={}
for n,s in seqs.items():
    if n=='CAEEL_DYF13':continue
    mp=nw(ref,s);maps[n]=mp
    arr=np.array(['-']*L,'<U1')
    for i,jj in enumerate(mp):
        if jj>=0: arr[i]=s[jj]
    cols[n]=arr
alnDF=pd.DataFrame(cols);alnDF.insert(0,'ce_pos',np.arange(1,L+1))
mat=alnDF[list(ORTHO)].values
frac_id=np.array([(r[r!='-']==r[0]).mean() if (r!='-').sum()>1 else np.nan for r in mat])
alnDF['frac_id']=frac_id
alnDF.to_csv('/agent/jobs/45cdd2ff-33f4-48dd-aecb-f650c9ff40d6/provenance/dyf13_ortholog_alignment.csv',index=False)

chl2ce={jj+1:i+1 for i,jj in enumerate(maps['CHLRE_IFT56']) if jj>=0}
CR={'IFT52':[16,21,22,23,24,25,26],
    'IFT70':[271,272,274,275,276,277,278,303,306,307],
    'IFT46':[13,14,15,16,17,20,21,22,244,248,249,250,251,252]}
trans={p:sorted({chl2ce[r] for r in rs if r in chl2ce}) for p,rs in CR.items()}
allc=sorted(set().union(*trans.values()))

# ---- AF model ----
pdb=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q95QT8-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=180).text
open('/agent/jobs/45cdd2ff-33f4-48dd-aecb-f650c9ff40d6/provenance/AF-Q95QT8-F1-model_v6.pdb','w').write(pdb)
an=[];rn=[];rid=[];xyz=[];bf=[];el=[]
for l in pdb.split('\n'):
    if not l.startswith('ATOM'):continue
    an.append(l[12:16].strip());rn.append(l[17:20].strip());rid.append(int(l[22:26]))
    xyz.append([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]);bf.append(float(l[60:66]))
    e=l[76:78].strip();el.append(e if e else l[12:16].strip()[0])
xyz=np.array(xyz);rid=np.array(rid);an=np.array(an);el=np.array(el);bf=np.array(bf)
plddt=pd.Series(bf).groupby(rid).mean().values
RAD={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80}
r_at=np.array([RAD.get(e,1.7) for e in el])+1.4
ns=200;ixs=np.arange(ns)+0.5
phi=np.arccos(1-2*ixs/ns);th=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*ixs
sph=np.c_[np.cos(th)*np.sin(phi),np.sin(th)*np.sin(phi),np.cos(phi)]
tr=cKDTree(xyz);mx=r_at.max();sa=np.zeros(len(xyz))
for i in range(len(xyz)):
    nb=np.array(tr.query_ball_point(xyz[i],r_at[i]+mx));nb=nb[nb!=i]
    pts=xyz[i]+sph*r_at[i]
    acc=np.ones(ns,bool) if len(nb)==0 else (np.linalg.norm(pts[:,None,:]-xyz[nb][None,:,:],axis=2)>=r_at[nb][None,:]).all(1)
    sa[i]=4*np.pi*r_at[i]**2*acc.mean()
TIEN={'ALA':129,'ARG':274,'ASN':195,'ASP':193,'CYS':167,'GLN':225,'GLU':223,'GLY':104,'HIS':224,'ILE':197,
'LEU':201,'LYS':236,'MET':224,'PHE':240,'PRO':159,'SER':155,'THR':172,'TRP':285,'TYR':263,'VAL':174}
rsa=(pd.Series(sa).groupby(rid).sum()/pd.Series(rn).groupby(rid).first().map(TIEN)).values
ca=np.full((L,3),np.nan);cb=np.full((L,3),np.nan)
for i in range(len(xyz)):
    k=rid[i]-1
    if an[i]=='CA': ca[k]=xyz[i]
    if an[i]=='CB': cb[k]=xyz[i]
cb=np.where(np.isnan(cb),ca,cb)
W=21
sm=np.array([np.nanmean(ca[max(0,i-W//2):min(L,i+W//2+1)],axis=0) for i in range(L)])
seg=np.where(plddt>70)[0]
pca=PCA(3).fit(sm[seg]);proj=pca.transform(sm[seg])[:,:2]
A=np.c_[proj,np.ones(len(proj))];bb=(proj**2).sum(1)
sol,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,bb,rcond=None)
cx,cy=sol[0]/2,sol[1]/2;R=np.sqrt(sol[2]+cx**2+cy**2)
cbp=pca.transform(cb)[:,:2];smp=pca.transform(sm)[:,:2]
face_score=np.linalg.norm(smp-[cx,cy],axis=1)-np.linalg.norm(cbp-[cx,cy],axis=1)
face=np.where(face_score>0,'concave','convex')

df=pd.DataFrame({'pos':np.arange(1,L+1),'aa':list(ref),'plddt':plddt,'rsa':rsa,'frac_id':frac_id,
                 'face_score':face_score,'face':face})
df['is_mapped_contact']=df.pos.isin(allc)
for p,v in trans.items(): df['contact_'+p]=df.pos.isin(v)
df['region']=np.where(df.pos<=30,'N-term extension (1-30)',
             np.where(df.pos<=324,'N-half TPR (31-324)','C-half TPR (325-574)'))

# ---- conserved surface patches ----
CONS_T=0.6; RSA_T=0.25
mask=(df.frac_id>=CONS_T)&(df.rsa>=RSA_T)&(df.plddt>70)
pts=cb[mask.values]
lab=DBSCAN(eps=11.0,min_samples=5).fit_predict(pts)
pos_sel=df.pos.values[mask.values]
patches=[]
for k in sorted(set(lab)):
    if k==-1: continue
    pr=sorted(pos_sel[lab==k])
    ov=sorted(set(pr)&set(allc))
    partners=sorted({p for p in trans if set(pr)&set(trans[p])})
    patches.append({'patch':f'P{k+1}','n_res':len(pr),
                    'mean_frac_id':round(df.set_index('pos').loc[pr,'frac_id'].mean(),2),
                    'mean_rsa':round(df.set_index('pos').loc[pr,'rsa'].mean(),2),
                    'span':f"{min(pr)}-{max(pr)}",
                    'n_overlap_mapped_contact':len(ov),
                    'explained_by':','.join(partners) if partners else 'UNEXPLAINED',
                    'residues':','.join(map(str,pr))})
P=pd.DataFrame(patches).sort_values('n_res',ascending=False)
print(f"Conserved (>={CONS_T}) surface (RSA>={RSA_T}) residues: {int(mask.sum())}; clustered into {len(P)} patches (DBSCAN eps=11A, min 5)")
print(P.drop(columns='residues').to_string(index=False))
for _,x in P.iterrows(): print(f"  {x['patch']}: {x['residues']}")
P.to_csv('/agent/jobs/45cdd2ff-33f4-48dd-aecb-f650c9ff40d6/provenance/dyf13_conserved_surface_patches.csv',index=False)
df.to_csv('/agent/jobs/45cdd2ff-33f4-48dd-aecb-f650c9ff40d6/provenance/dyf13_per_residue.csv',index=False)

print("\nRegion summary:")
print(df.groupby('region').agg(n=('pos','size'),mean_frac_id=('frac_id','mean'),mean_rsa=('rsa','mean'),
      mean_plddt=('plddt','mean'),mapped_contacts=('is_mapped_contact','sum')).round(3).to_string())
sub=df[df.plddt>70]
ct=pd.crosstab(sub.is_mapped_contact,sub.face); orr,pv=fisher_exact(ct.values)
print(f"\nFace use by mapped contacts (ordered residues): concave/convex = "
      f"{ct.loc[True,'concave']}/{ct.loc[True,'convex']} vs background {ct.loc[False,'concave']}/{ct.loc[False,'convex']}; Fisher OR={orr:.2f} p={pv:.3g}")
print(f"Arc fit: superhelical radius R={R:.1f} A; PC1-PC2 explains {pca.explained_variance_ratio_[:2].sum()*100:.1f}% of path variance")

# ---- figure ----
fig,axes=plt.subplots(3,1,figsize=(13,10),gridspec_kw={'height_ratios':[1.4,1,1.3]})
ax=axes[0]
ax.plot(df.pos,df.frac_id.rolling(9,center=True,min_periods=1).mean(),color='#333',lw=1.2,label='identity to DYF-13 (9-res mean, 10 orthologs)')
ax.fill_between(df.pos,0,1,where=(df.pos>324),color='#FFE9C7',alpha=.7,label='C-half: zero contacts in 8BD7')
cols_={'contact_IFT46':'#4C78A8','contact_IFT52':'#54A24B','contact_IFT70':'#E45756'}
for c,col in cols_.items():
    pp=df.pos[df[c]]
    ax.scatter(pp,[1.03]*len(pp),s=18,color=col,marker='|',label=c.replace('contact_','contacts ')+' (transferred)')
ax.set_ylim(0,1.12);ax.set_ylabel('fraction identical');ax.set_xlim(1,L)
ax.legend(fontsize=7,ncol=2,loc='lower left');ax.set_title('DYF-13 conservation and the IFT56 contacts transferred from PDB 8BD7')
ax=axes[1]
ax.plot(df.pos,df.plddt,color='#777',lw=.9);ax.axhline(70,ls='--',c='r',lw=.8)
ax.set_ylabel('AlphaFold pLDDT');ax.set_xlim(1,L)
ax.annotate('N-terminal IFT46/IFT52 anchor\nis predicted disordered (pLDDT 40-68)',xy=(20,45),xytext=(70,35),
            fontsize=8,arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->',lw=.8))
ax=axes[2]
sel=df[df.plddt>70]
ax.scatter(sel.pos,sel.face_score,c=sel.frac_id,cmap='viridis',s=12)
ax.axhline(0,color='k',lw=.8)
mc=sel[sel.is_mapped_contact]
ax.scatter(mc.pos,mc.face_score,facecolors='none',edgecolors='red',s=60,lw=1.2,label='mapped IFT-B contact')
ax.set_ylabel('concave (+) / convex (-)\narc-fit face score');ax.set_xlabel('DYF-13 residue');ax.set_xlim(1,L)
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.colorbar(ax.collections[0],ax=ax,label='fraction identical',pad=.01)
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
